title: Variable-length FT1.2 command frame
purpose: Exercise the IEC 60870-5-101 variable-length link-frame parser with duplicated length octets, an ASDU payload, checksum, and end delimiter.

messages.label: FT1.2 variable-length frame carrying a single command

expected_behavior: The receiver should recognize the variable-length frame, validate its repeated length and checksum, then parse the embedded single-command ASDU without process termination.
constraints_preserved: The frame uses 0x68 as both variable-length start delimiter and repeated start delimiter.
Both length octets are 0x0c and count the control byte, link address byte, and ten-byte ASDU.
The embedded ASDU uses type 45, corresponding to C_SC_NA_1 in the supplied type catalog, with one object and a four-byte command header context.
The checksum 0xc2 is the modulo-256 sum of the control, address, and ASDU bytes under the standard FT1.2 assumption.

The one-byte link address, checksum rule, and 0x16 end delimiter follow the recognized FT1.2 model and are inferred assumptions because the supplied excerpts enumerate start codes but do not fully specify the link-layer layout.
issue_safety_notes: The frame is a new variable-length structural analogue informed by the reported parser crash risk. It does not reproduce the historical byte sequence or its length and payload layout.
